title: Client Relations Administrator
description:
Role: Client Relations Administrator
Location: Northampton
Monday - Friday Full-time, Office based
Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 per annum (depending on experience)

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a professional and customer-focused Client Relations Executive to join a well-established and growing business based in Northampton.

As the first point of contact for customers, you will play a key role in delivering an outstanding client experience by handling telephone and webchat enquiries, qualifying leads, and directing customers to the appropriate sales team members. Alongside customer interaction, you'll support quality monitoring, compliance processes, customer reviews, and a variety of operational and administrative tasks.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service or administration experience looking to build a long-term career within financial services. Full training will be provided, with genuine opportunities for progression into a regulated sales support role for candidates looking to develop further.

Duties of a Client Relations Executive:
- Answer incoming telephone and webchat enquiries, qualifying and directing customers to the appropriate Sales Team member.
- Provide exceptional customer service and maintain a professional, engaging telephone manner.
- Keep the Customer Records Management system up to date with accurate client information and call summaries.
- Carry out quality monitoring of sales calls and provide constructive feedback to the Sales Team.
- Support complaints handling and assist with complaint resolution where required.
- Obtain Trustpilot and Google reviews from customers.
- Assist with customer due diligence and compliance processes following training.
- Support the Client Relations Team Manager and Director of Compliance & Operations with administrative and ad hoc duties.
- Ensure business processes are followed and maintained to a high standard.
- Provide additional support across the business as required.

What we would like from you:
- Previous experience in Customer Service, Account Management, Sales Support or an administrative role.
- A degree is preferred, with a minimum of A-Levels (or equivalent) at BBB or above.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Confident speaking with customers over the telephone and via webchat.
- Ability to multitask, including typing whilst speaking to customers.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Good Microsoft Office skills and experience using CRM or webchat systems would be advantageous.
- A positive, proactive approach with a willingness to learn.

Personal Attributes:
- Professional, friendly and engaging.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Calm under pressure and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Commercially aware.
- Self-motivated whilst also working effectively as part of a team.
- Positive attitude with a proactive, can-do approach.

If you're interested in this position please apply with your CV. Alternativley, if you know anyone who would be suitable please ask for them to send their CV to (url removed)

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Northampton
Salary: £25,500 - £26,000 per annum, plus a competitive annual bonus.
Hours: Full Time
Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Cover) until November 2027
Reporting To: Office Manager

About the Role

We have an exciting opportunity for a Customer Service Advisor to join our busy team in Northampton on a full-time fixed-term contract to provide maternity cover until November 2027.

This is a varied and fast-paced role where you'll be responsible for building strong customer relationships, managing a daily outbound call diary, processing orders, handling customer enquiries, and delivering exceptional levels of customer service. You'll also play a key role in supporting promotional activities and identifying opportunities to upsell products to customers.

If you enjoy speaking to customers, building long-term relationships and working as part of a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a daily outbound call schedule and proactively engage with customers.
- Handle a high volume of inbound calls, including customer enquiries, orders, complaints and delivery requests.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently via telephone, email and voicemail.
- Convert inbound customer interactions into future planned outbound opportunities.
- Take ownership of customer queries and resolve issues through proactive customer service.
- Promote company products, including own-brand ranges and current sales promotions.
- Identify upselling opportunities and promote products from the latest promotional campaigns.
- Work closely with Account Managers to support customer retention, composite selling and new business opportunities.
- Understand customer needs and recommend relevant products and services.
- Support general office administration duties, including order processing, filing, post handling and customer confirmations.
- Utilise available reports and internal systems to maximise sales opportunities and customer engagement.

Skills & Experience

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate:
- Excellent customer service skills with a customer-first approach.
- A confident, professional and personable telephone manner.
- Strong communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Good teamwork skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues.
- Experience using Microsoft Excel for spreadsheets and record management.
- Ability to learn and utilise internal systems, including Trinity.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Good product knowledge or the ability to quickly learn and understand product ranges.
- A positive attitude and a proactive approach to problem solving.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic, customer-focused and enjoy working in a busy environment. You'll be comfortable managing multiple priorities, building rapport with customers and contributing to the success of the wider team.

Apply Today

If you're passionate about delivering excellent customer service and are looking for a rewarding full-time opportunity with a well-established business, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a full-time fixed-term maternity cover position running until November 2027.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Northampton 27,000 - 29,000 DOE Temporary to Permanent

Are you an experienced Sales Administrator looking for a role where you can take ownership, work closely with customers and become a valued part of a growing business?

We're working with an established manufacturing business based in Northampton to recruit a Sales Administrator into a brand-new position created due to continued growth.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the commercial side of administration - speaking to customers, supporting sales activity, keeping things organised and making sure opportunities don't get missed.

You'll work closely with the sales team, supporting the day-to-day sales operation while also having the opportunity to get involved in areas such as reporting, customer analysis and some general business administration.

There is a small amount of finance administration within the role, including supporting with invoices and purchase orders, but the main focus is Sales Administration and customer support.

Why is this a great opportunity?

This is much more than a traditional sales admin position.

The role has been created from scratch, meaning you'll have the opportunity to put your own stamp on it, improve processes and take ownership rather than simply following the same routine every day.

The business is well established but continues to grow, offering the successful candidate the chance to develop alongside the company and build a long-term career.

You'll be joining a small, friendly team where people work closely together and everyone has an important part to play. If you're someone who likes being busy, getting involved and seeing the impact of your work, this could be a really good fit.

Who are they looking for?

We're looking for someone with previous experience in Sales Administration, Sales Support, Customer Service Administration or a similar commercial role.

You'll ideally be:
- Confident dealing with customers over the phone and email.
- Experienced in supporting a sales team and managing customer enquiries.
- Comfortable preparing quotations, processing orders and keeping customer information up to date.
- Confident using Sage - this is essential.
- Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Naturally proactive - someone who sees what needs doing and gets on with it.
- Commercially minded, with an interest in customers and sales.
- Confident working with spreadsheets, data and reports.
- Happy to get involved with some basic finance administration when required.

You do not need to be an accounts professional. We're primarily looking for a strong Sales Administrator with Sage experience, a confident telephone manner and the right attitude.

What's on offer?

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity, initially joining on a temporary basis for approximately 3 months, with the intention of moving into a permanent position following a successful placement and mutual suitability.

Once permanent, you'll receive:
- 28 days' annual leave.
- Paid Christmas shutdown, in addition to your holiday allowance.
- Private healthcare.
- Long-term career development opportunities.
- The chance to help shape a brand-new position.
- A varied role with genuine responsibility and scope to develop.
- A supportive, close-knit working environment.
- The opportunity to build a long-term career within an established and growing manufacturing business.

The person we're looking for

If you're a good Sales Administrator who enjoys speaking to customers, supporting sales and being proactive, we'd like to hear from you.

We're not looking for someone who needs to tick every box. More importantly, we're looking for someone with the right attitude, commercial mindset and willingness to get involved.

If you're looking for your next move and want a role where you can make an impact, develop your skills and grow with a business, this could be the opportunity for you.

Apply today or contact Impact Recruitment for more information.
